title: Standing source-depth capacity miner
objective: Prevent a healthy but externally blocked project from collapsing into green-and-stop behavior. These reusable non-primary roles inspect one foundation shard deeply, compare live source/tests/PRs/events against quality requirements, and create or recommend a concrete non-duplicate one-shot lane when useful work exists. They never unlock a major feature or claim engine evidence.

acceptance: green main alone is not a completion result
inspect existing lanes/PRs/events before proposing anything
do not duplicate an active or completed lane
prefer concrete defect, missing invariant, test gap, or integration gap
publish a structured FINDING or DEPENDENCY_DISCOVERED event even when no code edit is warranted
do not unlock Door/Chair/Player or claim Studio evidence
